subject.title: [Feishu] Interactive Card message content parsing missing

question: What agent-visible payload contract should Feishu interactive cards use across direct inbound cards, card-action form/select callbacks, and merge_forward card sub-messages?
rationale: Source proves the direct inbound parser gap, but exposing complete form/select/card data while preserving simple button-command behavior is a channel API/product shape decision.

options.title: Coordinate Narrow Plugin Fixes
options.body: Keep this issue as the broad tracker, land direct inbound parser reuse in the Feishu plugin, and review the linked callback-field and merge_forward items for their narrower payload details.

options.title: Reduce To Direct Inbound Cards
options.body: Retitle or split this issue so it only covers direct message_type interactive parsing and leaves callback fields and merge_forward entirely to their existing linked items.

options.title: Defer Full Payloads
options.body: Pause the broad work if maintainers decide agents should not receive full Feishu card/form payloads beyond existing text extraction without a separate design.

recommendation.title: Coordinate Narrow Plugin Fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the broad tracker, land direct inbound parser reuse in the Feishu plugin, and review the linked callback-field and merge_forward items for their narrower payload details.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata names this handle as the community-maintained Feishu/Lark plugin contact for the affected channel behavior.
